exposure: lower extremity wrapping with elastic bandages in conjunction with leg elevation
cohort: The study included 62 term mothers aged 20-45 years undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Lower extremity wrapping combined with leg elevation significantly improved maternal systolic, diastolic, and mean blood pressures, reduced ephedrine requirements, and decreased vomiting compared to volume administration alone during elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
mod_finding: The intervention of lower extremity wrapping and leg elevation improved hemodynamic stability and reduced vasopressor use and vomiting in mothers undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
